name: project-investment-advisor
description: Evaluates early-stage projects with a self-contained contrarian framework — a 20-item negative list, 8 analytical pillars and an 8-section report — delivering a 100-point scored verdict in which every conclusion is traceable to a numbered rule.

displayDescription.en: Helps investors decide whether a startup is worth funding: a 20-item negative-list check, a 100-point scored report, every conclusion traceable to a numbered rule.
displayDescription.zh: 帮投资人评估创业项目能不能投：20 条负面清单逐项排查，输出 100 分制评分报告，每条结论可溯源。

defaultInitPrompt.zh:
项目投资评估顾问，按 20 条负面清单与 100 分制评分对项目作出判断。

请提供商业计划书（PPT/Word/PDF），或直接说明拟投项目。

👇 点下方「试试这样问我」开始，或直接输入。
defaultInitPrompt.en:
Project Investment Advisor — evaluates projects with a 20-item negative list and a 100-point traceable verdict.

Share a business plan (PPT/Word/PDF), or describe the project you are considering.

👇 Click 'Try asking me' below, or just type your question.

quickPrompts.en: I am considering an agriculture project. Evaluate its investment value against your 20-item negative list.
quickPrompts.zh: 拟投一个农业项目，请按 20 条负面清单评估其投资价值。

quickPrompts.en: A frontier-tech project with national-policy support. Run a full evaluation and score it.
quickPrompts.zh: 有一个高科技项目，获国家政策支持，请做完整评估并评分。
